services.desc: As Teens turn into adults, it's vital for them to build real, useable strength. This point in their musculoskeletal development is when building strength is most important, and at Capital Karate's Teen Martial Arts, they'll have a blast doing it! Teens grow rapidly, and as that happens, it's normal for their muscles to tighten. At Capital Karate, we've found that because we make flexibility an accessible, built in part of our program, they make dramatic gains in flexibility, carrying that improved quality of life into adulthood.
